blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
blocks.zh: 语言制导的无人机导航主要侧重于长视距航线规划,使得短程,对象相对的飞行动作探索不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们制定了“飞翔一字”(Flow)任务,要求无人机将简明的自然语言教学、自我中心视觉观察和当前状态动态转化为持续的飞行行动。 流动既包括原始运动指令,也包括复杂的物体交互行为,评估运动意向理解和空间背景定位. 为了能够进行政策学习和闭路评估,我们采用了无人驾驶飞行器-飞行器(UAV-Flow)综合数据集,其中包括30 692个专家驾驶的、跨越八个不同运动类别的现实世界轨迹,以及10 109个具有特定任务完成标准的无人驾驶飞行器-飞行系统环境中的模拟轨迹。 此外,我们开发了FlowVLA,它通过Tail-Aware GRPO(TGRPO)进行模拟性实景演示预训和在线后培训。 通过利用团体奖励分配,TGRPO有效地强化了高回报动作序列. 通过对273起UAV-Flow-Sim事件进行评估,经过预先培训的FlowVLA取得了75.58%的中度成功率,比最强的基线高6.72个百分点,TGRPO在培训后进一步提升到93.16%,具有较高的样本效率。 物理无人驾驶航空器实验表明,在室内外现实世界的场景中,对物体相关指令的有力执行。 " 流动 " 共同为具备语言条件的飞行操作建立了一个新的基准和学习框架。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are widely deployed across diverse applications, serving as aerial perception platforms for object detection, tracking, counting, and human behavior understanding [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] , as well as enabling precision agriculture, infrastructure inspection, emergency response, and entertainment applications [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
In parallel, advances in motion planning and control have enabled increasingly autonomous flight and multi-UAV coordination in cluttered three-dimensional environments [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . These capabilities provide a technical foundation for UAVs to operate as embodied agents that interpret human intent and execute tasks in the physical world.
While modern UAVs are increasingly capable of autonomous flight, enabling them to follow high-level natural language instructions remains a fundamental challenge in achieving more intelligent human–UAV interaction. For example, executing a command such as “Fly 3 meters in front of me and take a photo" requires UAVs to transform abstract human intentions into executable physical actions.
This process demands that the system seamlessly interpret user intent, reason about the environment, and synthesize dynamically feasible, collision-free flight trajectories.
blocks.zh:
无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)被广泛部署在各种应用中,充当物体探测,跟踪,计数和人类行为理解的航空感知平台[1,2,3,4,5],以及使能精密农业,基础设施检查,应急,娱乐应用[6,7,8,9].
同时,在运动规划和控制方面的进步使飞行和多无人驾驶航空器在复杂三维环境中的协调日益自主[10、11、12、13]。 这些能力为无人驾驶飞行器提供了技术基础,使其能够作为体现的代理人运作,解释人类的意图,并在实际世界中执行任务。
现代 无人驾驶飞行器越来越能够自主地飞行,使其能够遵守高水平的自然语言指示,这仍然是实现更智能的人类-无人驾驶飞行器相互作用的根本挑战。 例如,执行诸如"我面前飞出3米并拍照"等命令,要求无人机将抽象的人类意图转化为可执行的物理动作.
这个过程要求系统无缝地解释用户的用意,环境的理由,并综合动态地可行,无相撞的飞行轨迹.

blocks.en:
In pursuit of language-guided aerial autonomy, recent efforts have extended vision-language navigation (VLN) paradigms from ground robots to UAV platforms [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] . Leveraging large-scale simulated environments [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 9 ] , these approaches enable UAVs to follow language instructions for long-horizon target search and goal-directed navigation tasks.
However, prevailing research mainly prioritizes high-level semantic reasoning and macro-level route synthesis [ 14 , 15 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] , operating on the premise that short-range execution can be offloaded to standard low-level planners and control modules [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . While this assumption has proven successful in many robotic systems, extending it to UAV platforms introduces additional challenges. UAVs must plan and execute dynamically feasible motions while avoiding obstacles in unconstrained 3D environments under real-world kinematic constraints [ 10 , 11 , 13 ] . As a result, enabling language-guided low-level flight maneuver remains a critical yet largely underexplored problem in the development of intelligent UAV systems.
blocks.zh:
为了追求由语言指导的航空自主,最近的努力将视觉语言导航范式从地面机器人扩展到无人驾驶航空器平台[14,15,16,17,18,19,20]. 利用大规模模拟环境[21,22,23,24,9],这些方法使无人机能够遵循语言指令来进行长视距目标搜索和瞄准方向导航任务.
然而,主流研究主要优先考虑高层次语义推理和宏观层面的路由合成[14,15,25,26,27,28],操作前提是短程执行可以卸入标准低级规划和控制模块[10,11,12]. 虽然这一假设在许多机器人系统中证明是成功的,但将其推广到无人机平台带来了更多的挑战. 无人驾驶飞行器必须规划和执行动态可行的动议,同时避免在现实世界动态限制下在不受约束的3D环境中设置障碍[10、11、13]。 因此,在开发智能无人驾驶飞行器系统方面,能够进行语言制导的低水平飞行操作仍然是一个关键而基本上未得到充分探讨的问题。

blocks.en:
We introduce the Flying-on-a-Word (Flow) task to formalize language-conditioned short-range maneuver execution. Given a concise instruction, egocentric observations, and UAV state estimates, the agent must interpret the intended motion and execute the corresponding flight behavior through closed-loop interaction. Flow covers primitive motion commands and object-interactive commands, assessing motion intent understanding and spatial context grounding.
To support systematic evaluation and policy learning on language-conditioned short-range UAV flight, we present UAV-Flow , the first large-scale benchmark that integrates real-world expert demonstrations with an interactive simulation suite. Specifically, UAV-Flow comprises 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories spanning eight major motion categories and diverse visual contexts. Complementing these demonstrations, UAV-Flow-Sim provides 10,109 simulated trajectories in an interactive environment, enabling controlled policy training and closed-loop evaluation.
We further develop an automated evaluation method for UAV-Flow-Sim to assess task success by jointly considering maneuver execution quality and final state instruction compliance.
blocks.zh:
我们提出飞行一字(花)任务,正式确定语言条件短距离机动执行。 鉴于简洁的指令,以自负为中心的观察,以及无人机状态估计,特工必须解释预期的运动,并通过闭路互动执行相应的飞行行为. Flow覆盖了原始运动指令和对象交互指令,评估运动意向理解和空间上下架.
为了支持对语言条件下的短程无人驾驶航空器飞行进行系统评价和政策学习,我们介绍了无人驾驶航空器-飞行标准,这是第一个将现实世界的专家示范与交互式模拟套件相结合的大规模基准。 具体来说,无人驾驶飞行器-飞行器包括30,692个专家驾驶的现实世界轨迹,跨越了八个主要运动类别和不同的视觉背景。 作为这些演示的补充,无人驾驶飞行器-飞行-西姆在互动环境中提供10,109个模拟轨迹,从而能够进行可控的政策培训和闭路评估。
我们进一步为无人驾驶飞行器-飞行系统开发一种自动评估方法,通过联合考虑机动执行质量和最终遵守国家指示来评估任务是否成功。

blocks.en:
Next, we introduce a staged policy learning framework that jointly exploits expert demonstrations and simulation-based interaction to make effective use of task-specific data. In the first stage, imitation learning is used to ground the policy in the distribution of expert flight behaviors, enabling the model to acquire instruction-compliant maneuvers from offline demonstrations. However, during closed-loop execution, control deviations can lead the policy to states outside the demonstration distribution.
We further improve the policy through environment interaction in UAV-Flow-Sim, using task-level completion feedback to guide policy optimization.
Guided by this task-level feedback, we seek to learn more effectively from the action sequences of trajectories with higher completion scores. Therefore, we build upon GRPO [ 29 ] and introduce a tail-aware advantage derived from the group reward distribution, producing tail-aware GRPO (TGRPO). This advantage construction assigns greater weight to reward intervals reached by fewer trajectories within each group, strengthening learning from high-reward execution while making fuller use of outcomes that are sparsely represented in group.
For physical deployment, we use a ground-drone collaborative architecture in which the ground station performs VLA inference and the UAV executes the commands. The execution layer selects look-ahead waypoints according to the measured end-to-end delay, accounting for UAV motion during communication and inference to support continuous closed-loop flight.
blocks.zh:
其次,我们采用分阶段的政策学习框架,联合利用专家示范和模拟互动,有效利用具体任务的数据。 在第一阶段,模仿学习被用来在分配专家飞行行为方面确立政策,使模型能够从离线演示中获得符合指令的操作。 然而,在闭路执行期间,控制偏差可以将政策引向演示分发以外的状态.
我们通过UAV-Flow-Sim的环境互动,利用任务级的完成反馈来进一步改进政策,以指导政策优化.
以这个任务层面的反馈为指导,我们想从完成分数较高的轨迹动作序列中更有效地学习. 因此,我们以GRPO[29]为基础,引入从团体奖励分配中获得的"尾-意识"优势,生产"尾-意识"GRPO(TGRPO). 这种优势构建赋予了更大的分量来奖励每个组内较少的轨迹所达到的间隔,加强了对高回报执行的学习,同时更充分地利用组内鲜有代表的成果.
在实际部署方面,我们使用地面-德龙协作架构,地面站执行VLA推论,无人机执行指令。 执行层根据测量到的端到端延迟来选择外观-前行方向点,计算通信过程中的无人机运动,并推断支持连续闭路飞行.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: (1) We define the Flying-on-a-Word (Flow) task, which formulates language-conditioned UAV navigation as fine-grained, short-range trajectory execution from egocentric observations, assessing the policy’s ability to understand motion intent and execute object-grounded spatial behaviors.
blocks.zh: (1)我们定义了飞行一字(花)任务,它将语言条件的无人驾驶飞行器导航定为精细的,短距离的轨迹从自负式的观测中执行,评估政策理解运动意图和执行被定位物体的空间行为的能力.

blocks.en: (2) We build UAV-Flow , a real-world expert demonstration dataset, and UAV-Flow-Sim , an interactive simulation suite, together forming the large-scale real-world benchmark for language-conditioned UAV short-range navigation. We also provide an automated task-level closed-loop evaluation protocol in the simulation benchmark.
blocks.zh: (2)我们建造了UAV-Flow,一个真实世界的专家演示数据集,以及UAV-Flow-Sim,一个交互式模拟套件,共同构成了语言条件化UAV短程导航的大规模真实世界基准. 我们还在模拟基准中提供了一个自动化的任务级闭路评估协议。

blocks.en: (3) We propose a staged policy learning framework that combines imitation learning and reinforcement learning through imitation pretraining on mixed real-world and simulated demonstrations, followed by closed-loop post-training with Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO).
blocks.zh: (3)我们提出了一个分阶段的政策学习框架,通过模拟实际世界的预训和模拟演示,将模仿学习和强化学习结合起来,然后用Tail-Aware GRPO(TGRPO)进行闭路后培训。

blocks.en: (4) We have conducted extensive experiments. The pretrained FlowVLA policy achieves a success rate of 75.58%, which TGRPO post-training further raises to 93.16%, achieving the highest overall success rate among evaluated methods. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the policy learning framework.
blocks.zh: (4)我们进行了广泛的试验。 事先经过培训的 " FlowVLA " 政策取得了75.58%的成功率,而TGRPO在培训后进一步提高到93.16%,在评估方法中实现了最高的总体成功率。 综合研究验证了政策学习框架的有效性。

blocks.en: This paper is built upon UAVFlow [ 30 ] , our conference version, and extends it in several important aspects. First, we further develop an upgraded closed-loop simulation evaluation suite, UAV-Flow-Sim , equipped with newly introduced automated task-level evaluation metrics for more fine-grained and reproducible assessment. Second, we develop FlowVLA with mixed-demonstration pretraining followed by online RL post-training, incorporating a tail-aware advantage into GRPO to strengthen learning from the action sequences of high-reward trajectories and improve success rates on challenging Flow tasks. Third, we provide a much more comprehensive experimental study, including comparisons with prior methods, ablation studies, and qualitative analyses. Compared with the conference version, the extended method achieves clear performance improvements and provides a more complete benchmark, training, and evaluation framework for language-conditioned UAV maneuvers.
blocks.zh: 本文以我们的会议版本UAVFlow [30]为基础,并在几个重要方面加以扩展。 首先,我们进一步开发一个升级后的闭路模拟评价套件UAV-Flow-Sim,它配备了新推出的自动化任务级评价度量衡,用于更精细和可再生的评估. 第二,我们开发FlowVLA,进行混合演示前培训,然后进行在线RL后培训,在GRPO中纳入了尾翼意识优势,以加强对高回报轨迹动作序列的学习,并改进挑战Flow任务的成功率. 第三,我们提供了一个更加全面的实验研究,包括与以前的方法进行比较,进行消化研究和定性分析。 与会议版本相比,扩展方法可以实现明显的性能改进,并为语言条件齐全的无人驾驶飞行器操作提供了更为完整的基准、培训和评价框架。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和基准

blocks.en:
Language-guided UAV research is evolving from vision-and-language navigation (VLN) toward vision-language-action (VLA) learning, while gradually extending from simulation-based studies toward real-world data. Early benchmarks primarily focus on long-horizon route or goal navigation in simulated environments. AVDN [ 31 ] investigates dialog-guided flight, while CityNav [ 18 ] extends goal-oriented navigation to reconstructed urban environments. AerialVLN [ 17 ] further studies long-horizon language-guided flight in city-scale simulations using a discrete 4-DoF action space.
Subsequent works explore more diverse task and action settings: OpenUAV [ 20 ] introduces continuous trajectories, OpenFly [ 19 ] scales up simulator-based aerial VLN, IndoorUAV [ 32 ] combines long-horizon VLN with short-horizon VLA data, and HUGE-Bench [ 33 ] evaluates high-level multi-stage VLA tasks. As shown in Table 1 , these benchmarks cover increasingly diverse tasks and action spaces, but the dataset and environment interactions remain primarily simulation-based.
Beyond navigation, AeroVerse [ 9 ] broadens the scope of aerial embodied intelligence to include scene awareness, spatial reasoning, navigational exploration, task planning, and motion decision-making.
Meanwhile, existing real-world UAV datasets mainly focus on visual perception [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 5 ] , with relatively few providing demonstrations that align language instructions, visual observations, UAV states, and executable actions for policy learning.
UAV-Flow [ 30 ] addresses this gap by providing real-world language-vision-action demonstrations for fine-grained flight control learning, together with UAV-Flow-Sim for reproducible closed-loop evaluation. This combination advances language-guided UAV research beyond simulation-based navigation toward learning and evaluating action policies grounded in real-world flight demonstrations.

blocks.en: 2.2 End-to-End Vision-Language-Action Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 最终展望-语言-行动模式

blocks.en:
End-to-end VLA models map visual observations and language instructions to executable actions. OpenVLA [ 34 ] autoregressively predicts discretized action tokens, whereas π 0 \pi_{0} [ 35 ] and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 36 ] employ flow-matching action experts conditioned on pretrained VLM features to generate continuous action chunks. Building on these architectures, OpenVLA-OFT [ 37 ] improves action generation and control efficiency through action chunking, parallel decoding, and continuous action regression. FAST [ 38 ] further improves the efficiency of autoregressive action prediction by compressing action chunks using discrete cosine transforms and byte-pair encoding. These methods leverage pretrained VLMs to jointly encode visual observations and language instructions, providing representations for language-conditioned action prediction.
Recent work further improves pretrained VLAs through reinforcement learning, through feedback collected during policy execution. VLA-RL [ 39 ] introduces trajectory-level online optimization, while SimpleVLA-RL [ 40 ] supports scalable training through VLA-specific rollout sampling and parallel execution. RIPT-VLA [ 41 ] uses sparse success rewards with dynamic sampling and leave-one-out advantage estimation. EXPO-FT [ 42 ] combines an action-editing policy with Q-guided candidate selection for sample-efficient adaptation in real-world manipulation.
blocks.zh:
从端到端的VLA模型映射出可执行动作的视觉观测和语言指令. OpenVLA [34] 自动地预测了被磁盘折叠的动作符,而 ^ 0\pi_{0} [35] 和 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} [36] 则使用以预先训练的 VLM 特性为条件的流量匹配动作专家来生成连续动作块. 基于这些架构,OpenVLA-OFT[37]通过动作分解,平行解码和连续动作回归来提高动作生成和控制效率. FAST [38] 通过使用离散的同位素变换和字节-派尔编码来压缩动作块来进一步提高自旋动作预测的效率. 这些方法利用预先训练的VLM来联合编码视觉观察和语言指示,为语言条件动作预测提供表示.

blocks.en: VLA models are also being extended to aerial robots. IndoorUAV combines indoor VLN with short-horizon π 0 \pi_{0} -based execution [ 32 ] , while CognitiveDrone [ 43 ] and RaceVLA [ 44 ] use velocity commands in simulation and on physical UAVs, respectively. AutoFly [ 45 ] integrates language guidance with obstacle-aware navigation. AirVLA [ 46 ] transfers manipulation-pretrained VLAs to aerial navigation and pick-and-place tasks, combining demonstrations synthesized with gaussian splatting and payload-aware inference-time guidance to accommodate flight dynamics. For language-conditioned UAV navigation, we adopt a two-stage VLA training framework: imitation pretraining on mixed real-world and simulated demonstrations, followed by online reinforcement learning through interaction in simulation.

blocks.en: 3 UAV-Flow Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 无人驾驶飞行器-飞行基准

blocks.en: This section introduces UAV-Flow, a benchmark for evaluating language-conditioned short-range UAV flight execution. The benchmark is centered on the Flying-on-a-Word (Flow) task, in which a UAV interpret a concise natural-language instruction and execute the corresponding fine-grained flight behavior based on onboard visual observations and proprioceptive feedback. In contrast to existing aerial vision-language navigation benchmarks, which primarily focus on high-level navigation and long-horizon decision making, UAV-Flow targets the execution of short-range, instruction-grounded maneuvers. It evaluates whether an agent can infer intended motion, ground spatial references in the current scene, and generate physically feasible UAV behaviors. These capabilities are essential for precise UAV operation yet are largely underexplored in existing benchmarks. To facilitate both policy learning and reproducible benchmarking, UAV-Flow provides expert-piloted real-world demonstrations for training with a complementary simulation suite that enables large-scale closed-loop evaluation under controlled conditions.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍UAV-Flow,这是评估语言条件短程UAV飞行执行的基准. 该基准以"飞行一字"(Flow)任务为中心,其中一款无人驾驶飞行器会解释简明的自然语言指令并基于机上视觉观察和自取回馈执行相应的精细的飞行行为. 与主要侧重于高水平导航和长视距决策的现有航空视觉语言导航基准不同,无人驾驶飞行器-Flow的目标是执行短程、以教学为基础的操作。 它评价一种物剂能否推断出当前场景中的意图运动,地面空间参考,并产生物理上可行的无人驾驶航空器行为. 这些能力对于精确的无人驾驶航空器行动至关重要,但在现有基准中基本上没有得到充分利用。 为了便利政策学习和可复制基准,无人驾驶飞行器-飞行器为培训提供专家驾驶的实地世界示范,配有辅助模拟套件,能够在控制条件下进行大规模闭路评估。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Representative Flow tasks. Examples show scene observations, natural-language instructions, and corresponding 3D flight trajectories for hovering, approaching, retreating, passing, orbiting, and landing. Multiple expert trajectories for the same instruction illustrate the diversity of demonstrated flight behaviors.

blocks.en: To study language-conditioned fine-grained UAV control, we introduce the Flying-on-a-Word (Flow) task setting, which aligns concise language instructions with short-range flight execution. Flow emphasizes visually grounded interactions and simple expert-pilot maneuvers, such as orbiting or passing around obstacles, rather than long-horizon route planning. Each Flow instance provides the UAV agent with three modalities at every time step: a natural-language instruction 𝐢 \mathbf{i} , the UAV 6-DoF state 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} expressed in an episode-local trajectory frame, and an egocentric visual observation 𝐨 t \mathbf{o}_{t} . The policy is expected to generate continuous UAV actions that reflect the instruction intent while satisfying dynamic feasibility: π θ : ( 𝐨 t , 𝐬 t , 𝐢 ) ↦ 𝐚 t . \pi_{\theta}:(\mathbf{o}_{t},\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathbf{i})\mapsto\mathbf{a}_{t}. (1) The action 𝐚 t \mathbf{a}_{t} is represented as a target pose or a position-yaw command in a local coordinate frame, which can be mapped to platform-specific flight controllers. Executing the policy over an episode of length T T produces an action sequence A = 𝐚 1 , 𝐚 2 , … , 𝐚 T A={\mathbf{a}_{1},\mathbf{a}_{2},\ldots,\mathbf{a}_{T}} and a state trajectory τ = 𝐬 1 , 𝐬 2 , … , 𝐬 T \tau={\mathbf{s}_{1},\mathbf{s}_{2},\ldots,\mathbf{s}_{T}} . A successful Flow trajectory should faithfully capture and execute the motion semantics conveyed by the instruction, align with spatial references in the observed scene, lead to the intended final state, and comply with UAV flight constraints.
blocks.zh: 为了研究语言条件精细的UAV控制,我们引入了"飞上一字"的任务设置,将简明语言指令与短程飞行执行相配合. 流动强调视网膜互动和简单的专家-驾驶操作,例如绕道或绕道障碍,而不是长视线路线规划。 每个 Flowext为无人驾驶飞行器代理器提供了每一步三种模式:自然语言指令i\mathbf{i},UAV 6-DoF状态 s t\mathbf{s}_{t}以插曲-局部轨迹框架表示,以及自心视觉观察o t\mathbf{o}_{t}. 该政策预计将产生反映指示意图并同时满足动态可行性的连续无人驾驶航空器行动:(o t, s t, i ) -- -- a t。 \ pi_{\theta} :(\ mathbf{o}_{t},\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathbf{i})\mapsto\mathbf{a}_{t} 。 (1)t\mathbf{a}_{t}的动作在局部坐标框中作为目标姿势或位置-yaw命令来表示,可以被映射到特定平台的飞行控制器上. 以一集长度 T T 执行策略生成一个动作序列 A = a 1, a 2, ..., a A = mathbf{a}_{1},\ mathbf{a}_{2},\ ldots,\ mathbf{a}_{T}}和状态轨迹 = s 1, s 2, ..., s\ tau={\mathb{ s}_{1},\ mathb{ s}_{2},\ ldots,\ mathb{ s}_{T}}. 成功的"流"轨迹应忠实地捕捉和执行指令所传达的运动语义,与被观测到的场景中的空间参考一致,导致预定的最终状态,并遵守无人机飞行限制.

blocks.en:
The Flow task is designed to evaluate two fundamental capabilities required for language-conditioned UAV flight execution. The first is motion intent understanding , which requires the policy to infer the desired flight behavior specified by the instruction, such as translating in a particular direction, rotating by a given angle, ascending, hovering, or landing.
The second is spatial context grounding , which requires the policy to map spatial references in natural-language instructions to corresponding objects or locations in visual observations and generate actions accordingly. Examples include approaching a vehicle, passing an object on a specified side, or stopping near a landmark.
Together, these capabilities enable the agent to map language instructions into physically feasible flight actions that faithfully capture the intended motion semantics and respect the spatial relationships in the observed scene.
blocks.zh:
Flow任务旨在评价具有语言条件的无人机飞行执行所需的两种基本能力。 第一种是运动意向理解(move intending understanding),它要求政策推断指令所指定的所期望的飞行行为,如向特定方向翻译,由特定角度旋转,上升,徘徊,或降落等.
第二是空间背景定位,这需要政策将自然语言指令中的空间参考物映射到视觉观测中相应的物体或位置并产生相应的行动. 例子包括接近车辆,通过指定一侧的物体,或停止在地标附近.
这些能力共同使物剂能够将语言指示映射到物理上可行的飞行动作中,忠实地捕捉到预定的运动语义并尊重被观测到的场景中的空间关系.

blocks.en: To evaluate these capabilities systematically, UAV-Flow organizes instructions into two categories: primitive motion commands and object-interactive commands. The former primarily assess the agent’s ability to understand and execute motion intent, while the latter further require grounding language in the surrounding scene and performing actions relative to referenced entities. The real-world dataset organizes expert demonstrations into eight major motion categories for statistical analysis, whereas UAV-Flow-Sim instantiates the same task formulation in simulation, replicating the real-world setup. This design disentangles instruction-level motion semantics from the scene entities and spatial relations that govern execution. Fig. 2 illustrates representative Flow trajectories.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评价这些能力,UAV-Flow将指令组织成两类:原始运动指令和物体交互指令. 前者主要评估代理人理解和执行动议意图的能力,而后者则进一步要求在周围的场景中打下基础,并就被提及实体采取行动。 现实世界数据集将专家演示分为8个主要运动类进行统计分析,而UAV-Flow-Sim在模拟,复制现实世界设置时即刻将相同任务配方进行. 这种设计将指令级运动语义从场景实体和支配执行的空间关系中分出. 图2说明了具有代表性的流程轨迹。

blocks.en: 3.2 Real-World Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 真实世界数据集

blocks.en: To capture expert flight behaviors, we construct UAV-Flow by collecting and annotating real-world flight demonstrations. Fig. 3 summarizes the data collection and annotation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为了记录专家的飞行行为,我们通过收集和注释真实世界的飞行演示来构建无人机-飞行. 图3总结了数据收集和注释程序。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of real-world UAV-Flow dataset construction. Expert pilots collect onboard videos and flight logs, followed by temporal synchronization and 6-DoF pose registration. Each flight demonstration is assigned a task label and a language instruction, followed by annotation review. The resulting UAV-Flow dataset pairs egocentric videos and flight trajectories with the corresponding instructions.
blocks.zh: 图3:真实世界无人机-花相机数据集建设概况. 专家飞行员在机上收集视频和飞行日志,然后是时间同步和6-DoF的出场注册. 每一次飞行演示均被分配任务标签和语言指导,并随后进行注释审查. 由此产生的无人驾驶飞行器-Flow数据集配对以自我为中心的视频和飞行轨迹,并附有相应的指令.

blocks.en: Trajectory acquisition. Data acquisition is conducted across three university campuses covering 5.02 km 2 . These campuses provide compact but diverse outdoor environments with pedestrians, vehicles, vegetation, buildings, roads, open spaces, and landmarks. Flights are manually operated by certified UAV pilots, each with over 800 hours of flight experience, using commercial-grade platforms such as the DJI Mavic 3T RTK equipped with 4K cameras and RTK GPS modules. These sensors provide high-resolution first-person-view videos and centimeter-level trajectory accuracy for trajectory reconstruction and multimodal alignment. To guide flight execution, we curate instruction templates spanning primitive motion commands ( e.g. , takeoff, shift, and rotate) and object-interactive behaviors ( e.g. , orbiting around a car or hovering beside a landmark). Pilots execute these instructions exclusively from the UAV’s onboard view, so the recorded visual stream matches the visual input available to a deployed policy. To increase behavioral coverage, each instruction is executed from multiple initial positions and viewing directions. Thus, semantically equivalent commands can produce diverse trajectories while preserving the same underlying intent.
blocks.zh: 轨迹取取. 数据采集在三个大学校园进行,面积5.02 km 2. 这些校园提供紧凑而多样的户外环境,有行人,车辆,植被,建筑,道路,空地和地标. 飞行由认证的无人机飞行员手动操作,每个飞行员拥有800多小时的飞行经验,使用商业级平台,如装备有4K相机和RTK GPS模块的DJI Mavic 3T RTK. 这些传感器提供高分辨率第一人称视野视频和厘米级轨迹精度,用于轨迹重建和多模式对接. 为了指导飞行执行,我们整理了涵盖原始运动指令(例如起飞、转动和旋转)和物体交互行为(例如绕一辆车行走或徘徊在地标上)的指令模板。 飞行员完全从无人机的机上视图执行这些指令,因此所录入的视觉流与所部署的政策可用的视觉输入相匹配. 为了增加行为覆盖,每个指令从多个初始位置和取景方向执行. 因此,同理等同的命令可以产生出不同的轨迹,同时保留同样的基本意图.

blocks.en: 6-DoF Pose Registration. Each demonstration contains synchronized onboard video and complete flight logs. Using precise timestamps, we temporally synchronize the two data streams by linearly interpolating each 6-DoF UAV state, including GPS coordinates and local orientation, at each timestamp of the associated video frame. This establishes a frame-wise correspondence between each visual observation and its concurrent UAV state. We then register the synchronized poses to an episode-local coordinate frame: GPS coordinates are transformed into a local cartesian frame centered at the trajectory start, while orientations are represented relative to the initial heading. Expert actions are derived from the synchronized flight logs and registered pose sequences, yielding pose commands consistent with the action used for policy learning. The aligned sequences are sampled at 5 Hz, producing temporally consistent tuples of visual observation, UAV state, and expert action.
blocks.zh: 6号线 Pose注册。 每次演示都包含同步上机视频和完整的飞行记录. 使用精确的时间戳,我们通过线性地插入每个6-DoF UAV状态,包括GPS坐标和局部取向,在相关视频帧的每个时间戳上对两个数据流进行时间同步. 这确定了每个目视观测与其同时存在的无人驾驶航空器状态之间的帧对应。 然后,我们将同步摆放器登记在一个插曲-局部坐标框上:GPS坐标被转换成以轨迹起跑为中心的地方笛卡尔帧,而取向则相对于起跑标题来表示. 专家行动源于同步飞行记录和已登记的姿势序列,产生与政策学习中使用的行动相一致的姿势命令。 对等序列以5Hz为样本,产生时间上一致的Tuple视觉观测,UAV状态和专家动作.

blocks.en: Instruction annotation. Language annotations are constructed through a quality-controlled process. Annotators first filter clips with ambiguous behaviors, unsafe execution, unclear scene relations, or inconsistent motion semantics. They then assign concise commands that describe the intended motion and, when needed, the spatial relation to a visible object. To support standardized annotation and efficient data processing, UAV-Flow adopts a fixed command set for canonical task labels, while constructing an open-vocabulary command set by paraphrasing the canonical annotations with large language models [ 47 ] . The resulting real-world dataset contains 30,692 trajectories across 8 major motion categories, paired with egocentric videos, aligned UAV states, and instructions.
blocks.zh: 指示注释. 语言说明是通过质量控制过程构建的. 注释者首先过滤片段,其行为模棱两可,执行不安全,场景关系不明确,或者运动语义不一致. 然后,它们会指定简明的指令,描述预期的运动,并在必要时描述与可见物体的空间关系。 为了支持标准化的注解和高效的数据处理,UAV-Flow采用一套固定的指令集来表示犬类任务标签,同时用大语言模型来将犬类注解作为参数来构建一个开口-vocabulary指令集[47]. 由此而来的现实世界数据集包含30,692个轨迹,跨越了8个主要运动类别,与以自负为中心的视频配对,对齐的无人驾驶飞行器状态,以及指令.

blocks.en: 3.3 Simulation Suite
blocks.zh: 3.3 模拟套件

blocks.en: UAV-Flow-Sim complements the real-world dataset by providing additional trajectories and a controlled environment for closed-loop policy evaluation. Within this environment, policies can be compared under identical initial states, scene layouts, and termination criteria.
blocks.zh: UAV-Flow-Sim通过为闭路政策评价提供额外的轨迹和控制环境来补充现实世界数据集. 在这种环境下,政策可以在相同的初始状态,场景布局和终止标准下进行比较.

blocks.en:
The simulator is built in a campus scene and uses UnrealCV [ 22 , 24 ] for rendering and UAV control. The UAV is controlled through a position-yaw interface that approximates the position-mode control used by practical UAV systems. The environment includes static landmarks and interactive objects such as humans, vehicles, and quadruped robots, enabling both primitive motion tasks and object-interactive tasks.
We collect the UAV-Flow-Sim dataset through a hybrid strategy that combines human piloting with rule-based trajectory generation. Human pilots manually execute complex flight instructions, while rule-based scripts handle instructions specifying fixed flight maneuvers. These scripts use privileged simulator information, including UAV states and object locations, to plan and execute trajectories for the prescribed maneuvers.
The dataset follows the same instruction, visual observation, and state format as the real-world data and contains 10,109 trajectories.
blocks.zh:
模拟器建于校园场景中,并使用UnrealCV [22,24]用于渲染和无人机控制. 无人驾驶飞行器通过一个近似实用无人驾驶飞行器系统所使用位置-仪表接口来控制. 环境包括静态地标和人,车辆等交互式物体和四重机器人,既能完成原始运动任务又能完成物体交互任务.
我们通过一种混合策略收集无人驾驶飞行器-飞行-西姆数据集,这种策略结合了人类试航和基于规则的轨迹生成. 人类飞行员手动执行复杂的飞行指令,而基于规则的脚本处理指令来指定固定的飞行操作. 这些脚本使用特权模拟器信息,包括无人驾驶飞行器状态和对象位置,为规定的操作计划和执行出轨.
数据集遵循与现实世界数据相同的指令,视觉观测,状态格式,并包含有10,109个轨迹.

blocks.en:
Closed-loop evaluation protocol. Each episode is initialized with a designated UAV pose and task instruction. At each step, the simulator feeds the current egocentric observation and UAV state to the policy, which in turn predicts an action. The simulator then executes this action and updates the environment before returning the subsequent observation. An episode terminates upon task completion, collision, safety violation, or horizon expiration.
The suite records the complete executed trajectory, terminal state, object relations, and collision events. These records allow us to examine how prediction errors affect subsequent flight behavior and whether policies recover from the resulting deviations during execution.
blocks.zh:
闭路评价协议. 每集都以指定的无人驾驶飞行器姿势和任务指示来初始化. 每一步,模拟器都会将当前以自负为中心的观测结果和无人机状态反馈到政策中,这反过来又预示着一项行动. 模拟器随后执行此动作并更新环境后再返回后续的观测. 一集在任务完成,相撞,安全违规,或地平线到期后终止.
该套房记录了完整已执行的轨迹,终端状态,对象关系,和相撞事件. 这些记录使我们能够审查预测错误如何影响随后的飞行行为,以及政策是否从执行过程中产生的偏差中恢复过来.

blocks.en: Task completion score. We upgrade the closed-loop evaluation protocol of UAV-Flow-Sim by introducing an automated task completion score. For each task type k k , an episode receives a normalized completion score C k ​ ( τ ) = C proc k ​ ( τ ) + C goal k ​ ( τ ) , C k ​ ( τ ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] , C_{k}(\tau)=C_{\mathrm{proc}}^{k}(\tau)+C_{\mathrm{goal}}^{k}(\tau),\quad C_{k}(\tau)\in[0,1], (2) where C proc k C_{\mathrm{proc}}^{k} measures execution of the intended maneuver and C goal k C_{\mathrm{goal}}^{k} measures whether the final UAV state satisfies the target condition. Both terms use task-specific predicates or tolerance scores. The completion score provides a graded measure of task fulfillment, reflecting both maneuver execution and terminal-state accuracy.

For example, in a passing task, C proc k C_{\mathrm{proc}}^{k} evaluates whether the UAV traverses the required passage or passes the specified object or region during execution, while C goal k C_{\mathrm{goal}}^{k} checks whether it stops at the target position. For rotation tasks, the score evaluates whether the UAV follows the commanded direction and achieves the required yaw change, accounting for deviations in terminal position and orientation. blocks.en: 3.4 Data Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 数据分析

blocks.en: UAV-Flow and UAV-Flow-Sim provide complementary coverage for Flow formulation. The real-world dataset contains 30,692 expert-piloted trajectories across 8 major motion categories, capturing diverse visual contexts, human control styles, and physically executed UAV dynamics. The simulation dataset contains 10,109 trajectories generated under matched instruction and state formats, enabling controlled testing and simulation-based policy optimization. We further construct a simulation test set comprising 273 annotated trajectories, covering all major action types in the dataset to facilitate systematic evaluation on the Flow task. Each test episode specifies its task label, initial state, instruction, reference trajectory, and task-specific completion criteria, establishing a reproducible protocol for closed-loop evaluation.
blocks.zh: 紫外线-花序和紫外线-花序-Sim为流配体提供补充覆盖. 真实世界数据集包含30,692个由专家驾驶的轨迹,跨越了8个主要运动类别,捕捉了不同的视觉环境,人的控制风格,以及实际执行的无人机动力学. 模拟数据集包含10,109个在匹配的指令和状态格式下产生的轨迹,能够进行有控制的测试和以模拟为基础的政策优化. 我们进一步构建一套模拟测试,包括273个附加说明的轨迹,涵盖数据集的所有主要行动类型,以利系统评价流程任务。 每个测试集都规定了其任务标签,初始状态,指令,参考轨迹,以及任务特定完成标准,建立了可复制的闭路评价协议.

Table 2 summarizes the trajectory distribution across action types in UAV-Flow and UAV-Flow-Sim. Approaching and passing account for the largest shares of the real-world dataset, whereas shifting and approaching are the most frequent actions in simulation. The distributions differ across the two datasets; in particular, hovering trajectories are present in the real-world data but absent from the simulation data.
Compared with existing aerial VLN datasets such as AerialVLN [ 17 ] , which prioritize long-range paths, discrete actions, and high-level route planning, UAV-Flow provides continuous expert trajectories and a closed-loop simulation suite tailored for short-range, language-conditioned motion execution and fine-grained spatial interaction. Reflecting this emphasis on precision and agility, most trajectories in UAV-Flow span under 20 meters in length.

blocks.en:
This section presents FlowVLA’s model architecture, two-stage policy learning, and real-world deployment method. The policy predicts short-horizon action chunks from egocentric images, UAV state, and natural-language instructions. As shown in Fig. 4 , the first training stage uses mixed demonstrations from UAV-Flow and UAV-Flow-Sim for imitation learning. The second stage performs online reinforcement learning post-training in simulation suite using Tail-Aware GRPO. It constructs advantages from the group reward distribution to better exploit rare high-reward trajectories, giving trajectories with high completion scores greater influence on policy updates toward higher task completion.
For real-world deployment on physical hardware, we adopt a ground-drone collaborative architecture. By scheduling execution waypoints according to end-to-end delay, this design bridges discrete policy predictions with continuous closed-loop execution in the real world.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍FlowVLA的模式架构、两阶段政策学习和现实世界部署方法。 政策预测短视行动与以自我为中心的图像、无人驾驶飞行器状态和自然语言指示相去甚远。 如图4所示,第一训练阶段采用UAV-Flow和UAV-Flow-Sim的混合演示来进行模仿学习. 第二阶段使用Tail-Aware GRPO进行模拟套件的在线强化后学习。 它构筑了集团奖励分配的优势,以便更好地利用稀有的高回报轨迹,使高完成分数的轨迹对政策更新产生更大的影响,以达到更高的任务完成率。
对于实际世界在物理硬件上的部署,我们采用地德合作架构. 通过根据端到端的延迟来排出执行路由点,这种设计桥接离散的政策预测,在现实世界中持续地进行闭路执行.

blocks.en: 4.1 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 示范建筑

blocks.en: Our policy consists of a pretrained Qwen3-VL [ 49 ] backbone and a lightweight discrete action head. At each time step t t , the policy receives the initial episode image, the current egocentric image, the UAV state, and a natural-language instruction. The initial image provides a persistent scene reference, while the current image supplies visual feedback for closed-loop control. For simplicity, the UAV state is represented as ( x t , y t , z t , ψ t ) (x_{t},y_{t},z_{t},\psi_{t}) in the episode-local trajectory frame, where ψ t \psi_{t} denotes yaw. These state values are serialized as text and concatenated with the language instruction to form the model’s text input.
blocks.zh: 我们的政策包括一个训练有素的Quen3-VL[49]骨干和一个轻量级离散动作头. 在每一步t t 时, 政策会收到初始的插曲图像, 当前的自我中心图像, 无人机状态, 以及自然语言的教学。 最初的图像提供了一个持久的场景参考,而目前的图像为闭路控制提供视觉反馈. 简而言之,无人驾驶飞行器状态在插曲-局部轨迹框架中被表示为 (x t, y t, z t, ψ t (x_{t}, y_{t}, z_{t},\ psi_{t}),其中"t \ psi_{t"表示为 yaw. 这些状态值被序列化为文本,并与语言指令相配合以形成模型的文本输入.

blocks.en: The Qwen3-VL backbone jointly processes visual tokens from the two images, the state-instruction text, and H H action tokens appended to the input sequence. The final-layer hidden state of each action token serves as an action query corresponding to one future control step. A lightweight MLP action head maps these queries to action distributions for the future control steps, predicting a chunk of H H four-dimensional position-yaw actions in the local coordinate frame, 𝐀 t = [ 𝐚 t , 1 , … , 𝐚 t , H ] \mathbf{A}_{t}=[\mathbf{a}_{t,1},\ldots,\mathbf{a}_{t,H}] .

blocks.en: To construct the discrete action space, we normalize each action dimension using percentile-based statistics computed from the training set and uniformly divide each normalized dimension into K K bins. The lightweight action head outputs categorical logits 𝐙 t ∈ ℝ H × 4 × K \mathbf{Z}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times 4\times K} , where 𝐙 t , h , j \mathbf{Z}_{t,h,j} corresponds to the categorical prediction for the j j -th action dimension at the h h -th future step. This discrete representation captures action distributions across UAV maneuvers and provides action log-probabilities for subsequent policy-gradient optimization. Each predicted action chunk forms a short-horizon local motion plan that can be executed by the controller.

blocks.en: 4.2 Hybrid Imitation Pretraining
blocks.zh: 4.2 混合模仿

blocks.en:
We pretrain the policy by imitation using a mixture of real-world flight demonstrations from UAV-Flow and simulated demonstrations from UAV-Flow-Sim. Both sources follow a unified episode format and are expanded into frame-level training samples.
The pretraining dataset comprises approximately 20,000 demonstration trajectories. While real-world demonstrations provide authentic outdoor visual diversity, sensor stochasticity, and physical motion dynamics, simulated demonstrations offer controllable and scalable coverage of Flow maneuvers and task configurations. Jointly training on these complementary data sources enables the policy to map egocentric visual observations, UAV states, and language instructions into future action chunks.

blocks.en: 4.3 RL Post-Training
blocks.zh: 4.3 RL 培训后

blocks.en: Imitation pretraining learns language-conditioned flight control from expert demonstrations, but primarily covers states along expert trajectories. During closed-loop execution, control deviations can shift subsequent observations away from the demonstration distribution, leading to compounding errors. To improve the policy’s ability to handle states induced by its own execution, we perform reinforcement learning post-training in UAV-Flow-Sim, further optimizing the policy through environment interaction and task-level feedback.
blocks.zh: 模仿预训从专家演示中学习语言条件飞行控制,但主要包括沿专家轨迹的状态. 在闭路执行期间,控制偏差可以使后续观测偏离演示分布,导致复合出错. 为了提高政策处理自身执行所引发的状态的能力,我们在无人驾驶飞行器-飞行系统(UAV-Flow-Sim)进行强化后学习培训,通过环境互动和任务级反馈进一步优化政策。

blocks.en: We use GRPO [ 29 ] as the basis for closed-loop policy optimization. For each task context, the rollout policy π old \pi_{\mathrm{old}} generates a group of trajectories { z i } i = 1 G \{z_{i}\}_{i=1}^{G} , whose relative performance provides the policy update signal. Each trajectory alternates action-chunk prediction and execution until the episode terminates. We evaluate the executed trajectory using the task completion score C k C_{k} defined in the benchmark, and denote the task reward for trajectory i i by r i = C k ​ ( z i ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] r_{i}=C_{k}(z_{i})\in[0,1] . This score jointly measures how well maneuver execution and the terminal state satisfy the task requirements, allowing group comparisons to distinguish trajectory completion quality.

However, UAV tasks require coordinated action sequences to execute the instructed maneuver and satisfy the terminal-state requirements. Trajectories sampled in the same task context may achieve different levels of completion, and some groups may contain only a few high-reward trajectories. We therefore seek to learn more effectively from trajectories with higher completion scores, reinforcing the action sequences that better satisfy the task requirements while making fuller use of high-quality outcomes that are sparsely represented within their groups.

blocks.en: To better exploit these rare trajectories, we adopt a reweighting towards high-reward outcomes and construct advantages based on the group reward distribution [ 50 , 51 , 52 , 53 ] . Specifically, we focus on the upper reward tail and assign weights according to how frequently different reward thresholds are exceeded, giving greater weight to reward intervals reached by fewer trajectories. Incorporating this advantage construction into GRPO yields Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO).

blocks.en: 4.4 Real-World Deployment

blocks.en:
To deploy the trained policy on a physical UAV, we use a ground-drone collaborative execution architecture, as illustrated in Fig. 5 . Due to limited onboard computing resources, VLA inference is performed on the ground station.
The UAV transmits egocentric images and state estimates to the ground station via a wireless link. Based on the received observations and language instruction, the ground station generates action chunks, converts them into control targets, and transmits them back to the UAV for execution by its onboard flight controller.

为了运用训练有素的无人驾驶飞行器政策,我们使用地面合作执行架构,图5说明了这一点。 由于机上计算资源有限,VLA推论在地站进行.
无人机通过无线链接向地面站传送以自我为中心的图像和状态估计. 根据收到的观测结果和语言指示,地面站生成动作块,将其转换为控制目标,并传送回无人机由机上飞行控制器执行.

blocks.en: The policy outputs position-yaw actions in a local coordinate frame. The execution layer decodes the discrete predictions into continuous actions and incrementally converts each action chunk into position-yaw waypoints using the UAV pose associated with the input observation.
blocks.zh: 政策产出在地方协调框架内开展定位行动。 执行层将离散预测解码为连续动作,并使用与输入观测相联的无人驾驶飞行器将每个动作块逐渐转换为位置-弯曲道点.

Smooth and continuous flight requires the execution layer to account for the latency between observation acquisition and command dispatch. Pausing UAV motion while waiting for inference to complete would introduce interruptions, compromising the continuous execution required by Flow tasks.
Conversely, allowing the UAV to continue moving during inference may render the initial waypoints in the returned action chunk outdated relative to the UAV’s current execution state. To address this issue, we adopt a delay-aware waypoint selection strategy. Let δ \delta denote the measured delay from image capture to command dispatch, and let f c f_{c} denote the execution frequency of the predicted waypoints. The execution layer skips the first m = min ⁡ ( H − 1 , ⌈ δ ​ f c ⌉ ) m=\min\left(H-1,\left\lceil\delta f_{c}\right\rceil\right) waypoints in the chunk and dispatches the remaining target.
By compensating for the elapsed time during communication and inference, this mechanism aligns the predicted waypoints with the current execution progress, enabling continuous closed-loop flight.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: We assess FlowVLA through closed-loop simulation, ablation studies, and physical UAV deployment. We first compare the pretrained policy with adapted baselines and evaluate the effects of GRPO and TGRPO post-training on task completion and trajectory similarity. Ablation studies then compare alternative RL algorithms and examine the effects of training-data composition, action representation, and VLM feature selection. Finally, we present flight execution examples in outdoor and indoor real-world scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们通过闭路模拟、衰竭研究和实际无人驾驶飞行器部署来评估FlowVLA。 我们首先将经过预先培训的政策与经过调整的基线进行比较,并评估GRPO和TGRPO在任务完成和轨迹相似方面培训后的效果。 然后对替代的RL算法进行比较并审查培训数据组成、动作表现和VLM特征选择的效果。 最后,我们介绍了户外和室内真实世界中飞行处决的例子。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Training and evaluation dataset. The pretraining set comprises 9,766 real-world trajectories selected for task balance and trajectory quality, together with 10,109 simulated trajectories, totaling 19,875 trajectories and 946,607 frames. For closed-loop evaluation, we additionally construct 273 annotated UAV-Flow-Sim test episodes in the same campus scene used to collect the simulated demonstrations. Each episode specifies an initial state, an instruction, a reference trajectory, and task-specific completion criteria.
blocks.zh: 培训和评价数据集。 预训集由9,766个为任务平衡和轨迹质量选择的活地轨组成,并有10,109个模拟轨迹,共计有19,875个轨迹和946,607个帧. 对于闭路评估,我们额外构建了273个附加注释的UAV-Flow-Sim测试场景,在同一场景中,用于收集模拟演示. 每集都指定了初始状态,指令,参考轨迹,以及特定任务完成标准.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol and metrics. All methods follow the closed-loop evaluation protocol in Sec. 3.3 , using the same initial state and language instruction for each test episode. Episodes terminate upon task completion, collision, or reaching the maximum horizon; an episode is counted as successful when all applicable task completion criteria are satisfied. We report success rate (SR), completion score (CS), and NDTW, which measure the proportion of successful episodes, the degree of task completion, and the similarity between executed and reference trajectories, respectively.
blocks.zh: 评估程序和衡量标准。 所有方法都遵循了第3.3 Sec. 的闭路评价协议,每集测试使用相同的初始状态和语言指令. 当任务完成、相撞或达到最大视野时,该集终止;当符合所有适用的任务完成标准时,该集被算作成功。 我们分别报告成功率(SR),完成分数(CS)和NDTW,它们分别衡量成功分数的比例,任务完成程度,以及执行和参考轨迹的相似性.

blocks.en: Supervised pretraining. Our FlowVLA policy uses a Qwen3-VL backbone and a discrete action head. Conditioned on the initial and current images, UAV state, and instruction, it predicts a ten-step position-yaw action chunk, with 256 bins for each of the four action dimensions. With trajectories sampled at 5Hz, each action chunk spans 2s. Supervised pretraining fine-tunes the VLM through LoRA and trains the action head with categorical cross-entropy on the mixed dataset using the AdamW optimizer. We pretrain FlowVLA for 80,000 steps on eight NVIDIA L40 GPUs. The learning rate is warmed up to 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} over the first 10,000 steps, followed by cosine decay, with gradient clipping set to 1.0.
blocks.zh: 监督预训. 我们的FlowVLA政策使用Quen3-VL主干线和独立的动作头. 它以初始图像和当前图像、无人驾驶飞行器状态和指令为条件,预测一个十步位置-线形动作块,四个动作维度中每个有256个宾箱。 轨迹取样在5Hz, 每个动作块跨2s。 监督预训通过LORA对VLM进行微调,并使用AdamW优化器在混合数据集上用绝对的跨入来训练动作头. 我们在8个NVIDIA L40 GPU上预训了8万步的FlowVLA. 学习速度在前一万步上被取暖到2×10−4 2.\times 10×4},后是余弦衰变,梯度剪接设置为1.0.

blocks.en: RL post-training. Within the SimpleVLA-RL framework [ 40 ] , we perform online post-training with GRPO and TGRPO, each initialized from the same pretrained FlowVLA policy. Training covers Pass, Rotate, Land, and Approach, with 204 training trajectories per task and a total of 90 policy update steps. Both methods leverage FSDP across four GPUs to optimize the LoRA parameters and action head with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , using a PPO clipping range of ϵ low = ϵ high = 0.2 \epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}=\epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.2 . At each RL iteration, we sample 8 closed-loop rollout trajectories per task across 16 parallel task configurations at temperature T = 1.6 T=1.6 , yielding 128 rollout trajectories per iteration with a maximum horizon of 100 simulator interactions per rollout. We then perform one optimization epoch over the collected batch with a global mini-batch size of 16 trajectories, executing 8 optimizer steps per iteration. At the end of each episode, the trajectory-level completion score serves as terminal feedback for advantage construction and policy updates. Greedy decoding is employed during evaluation.

blocks.en: 5.2 Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 基准模式

blocks.en: We select five representative methods as baselines and adapt them to the Flow task. All baselines are trained by imitation learning on the same simulated demonstrations, with their VLM components fine-tuned using LoRA. To provide a common closed-loop execution interface, each model’s outputs are converted to local position-yaw commands and executed by the same simulator-side controller.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了5个具有代表性的方法作为基线,并使之适应流量的任务。 所有基线都通过在同一模拟演示上进行模仿学习来进行训练,其VLM组件使用LORA进行微调. 为了提供一个常见的闭路执行接口,每个模型的输出被转换为局部位置-yaw命令,由同一位模拟器-侧控制器执行.

blocks.en: TravelUAV [ 20 ] uses a hierarchical architecture: a multimodal language model predicts a target pose from the current observation, UAV state, and task instruction, followed by a fine-grained trajectory decoder that generates a local flight trajectory. OpenVLA-UAV [ 34 ] autoregressively predicts discretized action tokens from visual observations and language instructions. MemoryVLA-UAV [ 54 ] maintains separate memory banks for historical visual features and instruction-conditioned semantic features, combining retrieved memories with current observation features to condition a diffusion model for action-sequence generation. π 0 \pi_{0} -UAV [ 35 ] generates continuous action chunks through a flow-matching action expert conditioned on VLM features. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} -UAV [ 36 ] builds on this framework with heterogeneous robot data and semantic supervision to improve cross-task generalization.
blocks.zh: TravelUAV [20] 使用分级架构:一种多模式语言模型从当前观测,UAV状态和任务指令中预测出一个目标外观,然后是可生成局部飞行轨迹的细纹轨迹解码器. OpenVLA-UAV [34] 自动地预测了从视觉观察和语言指令中产生的盘式动作符号. MemoryVLA-UAV [54] 为历史视觉特征和有指导条件的语义特征分别维持了内存库,将被检索的记忆与当前观测特征相合并,以作为行动序列生成的传播模型的条件. 0\\pi\0} - UAV [35] 通过一个以VLM 特性为条件的相流动作专家生成连续动作块 。 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}-UAV [36] 在这个框架的基础上发展出各种机器人数据和语义监督,以改善跨任务概括.

FlowVLA denotes the policy obtained by imitation pretraining on mixed real-world and simulated demonstrations. FlowVLA-GRPO and FlowVLA-TGRPO denote variants that undergo RL post-training from this policy using the corresponding algorithm.
To examine both optimization efficiency and performance on these tasks, we evaluate all policies on the full test set, quantifying performance improvements on the four RL training tasks alongside capability retention on the remaining tasks.

blocks.en: Overall performance. Table 3 shows that our pretrained policy achieves a mean overall SR of 75.58%, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline π 0 \pi_{0} -UAV at 68.86%, by 6.72 percentage points. Its mean overall NDTW of 0.402 is lower than π 0 \pi_{0} -UAV’s 0.431 but higher than those of the remaining baselines. These results demonstrate that FlowVLA achieves a superior overall success rate compared to existing baselines, providing a strong initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning post-training.

RL post-training performance. As shown in Table 3 , FlowVLA-GRPO and FlowVLA-TGRPO, initialized from the same pretrained policy, both improve overall task completion, achieving mean overall SRs of 92.06% and 93.16%, respectively. FlowVLA-TGRPO raised the gain to 17.58 percentage points over the pretrained policy and by a further 1.10 percentage points over FlowVLA-GRPO. These improvements extend across all four RL training tasks: FlowVLA-TGRPO increases SR by more than 20 percentage points each of Pass, Rotate, Land, and Approach, achieving over 90% SR on all four tasks.
These RL-refined models achieve mean overall nDTW scores of 0.434 and 0.424, respectively, both outperforming the pretrained policy. These results suggest that RL post-training enhances end-task completion while simultaneously improving alignment with the reference trajectories.
Task-wise results further show that FlowVLA-TGRPO’s gains over FlowVLA-GRPO are more pronounced on Pass and Approach. With the same policy initialization and training configuration, these results support the effectiveness of the tail-aware advantage in further improving task success rates.

blocks.en: Comparison of RL algorithms. To examine the effects of different RL algorithms on post-training, we further compare GRPO with DAPO [ 55 ] , GSPO [ 56 ] , and GDPO [ 57 ] , all initialized from the same pretrained FlowVLA policy. GDPO and GRPO use the same clipping parameters and both apply KL regularization relative to a reference policy. DAPO and GSPO instead set the upper clipping bound to 0.28 and do not use reference-policy KL regularization. As shown in Table 4 , GRPO achieves an overall SR of 92.06% and an overall NDTW of 0.434, both the highest among the four methods.

blocks.en: The training curves in Fig. 6 (a) further illustrate how these methods perform over the course of training. Overall SR generally increases for FlowVLA-GRPO and FlowVLA-GDPO, while GSPO remains near 90% in later training and DAPO declines substantially. FlowVLA-GRPO maintains relatively high NDTW in later training, whereas FlowVLA-GDPO and FlowVLA-GSPO show declines. The late-stage performance degradation of FlowVLA-DAPO and FlowVLA-GSPO may be partly related to their lack of reference-policy KL regularization, as their updates do not explicitly constrain cumulative deviation from the pretrained reference policy.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 (b) further distinguishes performance changes on the four RL training tasks from those on the remaining tasks. FlowVLA-GRPO substantially improves all four training tasks while recovering from an early decline on the remaining tasks and returning close to the pretrained level by the end of training. FlowVLA-TGRPO also improves all four training tasks and reaches a high success rate on Rotate early in training, but its mean SR on the remaining tasks declines slightly during later training. GSPO likewise shows a small decline on the remaining tasks, whereas GDPO and DAPO exhibit larger declines. Together with the overall results above, these findings show that FlowVLA-GRPO offers a favorable combination of task completion, reference-trajectory similarity, and retention of pretrained capabilities, supporting its use as the basis for further improvements to advantage computation. FlowVLA-TGRPO achieves a higher overall success rate. Although its performance loss on the remaining tasks is slightly greater than GRPO’s, it is substantially smaller than those of GDPO and DAPO, indicating that TGRPO further improves completion of the training tasks while largely retaining pretrained capabilities.

Model variants. We further replace the discrete action head with a FAST head trained on the same mixed data. FAST compresses quantized frequency-domain representations of action chunks into token sequences for autoregressive prediction [ 38 ] . With this replacement, mean SR and NDTW are 64.10% and 0.340, respectively, both below the default head’s 75.58% and 0.402.
We also examine the effect of fusing features from multiple VLM layers on action prediction, using an ELMo-style scalar mix [ 58 ] to form a weighted combination of all Qwen3-VL hidden states, including the embedding output. This variant achieves a mean SR of 76.19% and a mean NDTW of 0.419, improving over the default final-layer features by 0.61 percentage points and 0.017, respectively. Given the small gain in task success rate, we retain the model using only final-layer features as the common initialization for all RL post-training experiments.

blocks.en: 5.5 Real-World Deployment
blocks.zh: 5.5 实际世界部署

blocks.en: Following the deployment scheme in Sec. 4.4 , we deploy VLA policy on a physical UAV and evaluate its ability to execute language instructions in closed-loop flight in outdoor and indoor scenes. During flight, the UAV continuously transmits egocentric images and state estimates to the ground station, which predicts action chunks. The execution layer converts the predictions into waypoint commands, selects look-ahead waypoints based on the end-to-end delay, and dispatches them to the flight controller, maintaining continuous closed-loop flight despite communication and policy-inference delays.
blocks.zh: 继第4.4节的部署计划之后,我们部署关于实际无人驾驶飞行器的VLA政策,并评价其在室外和室内场景的闭路飞行中执行语言指令的能力。 在飞行期间,无人机不断向地面站传送以自我为中心的图像和状态估计,地面站预测动作块. 执行层将预测转换为出站点命令,根据端到端的延迟选择外观-前行方向点,并发送到飞行控制器上,尽管沟通和政策推论延迟,但仍保持连续闭路飞行.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce Flying-on-a-Word (Flow) to study UAV execution of short-range maneuvers from natural-language instructions, egocentric observations, and the current state. To support this task, we construct UAV-Flow, a real-world dataset of 30,692 expert-piloted trajectories, and UAV-Flow-Sim, which provides 10,109 simulated demonstrations and a closed-loop evaluation environment. Building on these resources, FlowVLA undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-world and simulated demonstrations, followed by online post-training in simulation with Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO).
Across 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, FlowVLA pretrained on mixed demonstrations achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%. Subsequent TGRPO post-training further improves the success rate to 93.16% with substantially fewer training updates, demonstrating faster convergence and improved sample efficiency.
Despite these strong simulation results, key practical limitations remain. Current high-rate closed-loop control relies heavily on ground-station computation and wireless communication, introducing latency risks and constraining real-time onboard autonomy. In future work, we will focus on model compression and edge-efficient deployment to enable low-latency onboard inference, such as quantization, distillation, and optimized architecture design. We will also scale up and diversify the training data across environments and tasks to improve generalization to unseen scenes and instructions. Furthermore, we will explore policy optimization strategies that jointly balance task completion, trajectory quality, and the preservation of previously learned capabilities.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了飞行-一字(花),研究无人机执行来自自然语言指令的短距离动作,自我中心观察,以及现状. 为支持这一任务,我们构建了由30,692个专家驾驶轨迹组成的现实世界数据集UAV-Flow和UAV-Flow-Sim,它们提供了10,109个模拟演示和闭路评价环境. 在这些资源的基础上,FlowVLA接受了关于混合现实世界的模拟预训和模拟演示,然后与Tail-Aware GRPO(TGRPO)进行模拟的在线后培训.
在273起UAV-Flow-Sim事件中,FLFVLA在混合示威中预先接受训练,取得了75.58%的平均成功率。 随后的TGRPO培训后,成功率进一步提高到93.16%,培训更新率大幅降低,显示集成速度更快,样本效率得到提高.
尽管取得了这些强有力的模拟结果,但关键的实际局限性依然存在。 目前的高速率闭路控制严重依赖地站计算和无线通信,引入了潜伏风险并制约了机上实时自主. 在未来的工作中,我们将注重模型压缩和边缘高效部署,以促成低纬度的机上推论,如量化,分馏,优化架构设计等. 我们还将扩大各种环境和任务的培训数据并使之多样化,以改善对看不见的场景和指示的概括。 此外,我们将探讨政策优化战略,以共同兼顾任务完成、轨迹质量和保留以前学到的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 9 compares FlowVLA and its TGRPO-post-trained policy on paired test episodes covering eight task types. In Shift, TGRPO more closely follows the requested displacement and succeeds where FlowVLA fails. In Rotate, TGRPO executes a clockwise rotation of 89.9 ∘ 89.9^{\circ} for a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} instruction, correcting FlowVLA’s overshoot to 200.6 ∘ 200.6^{\circ} . In Pass, TGRPO successfully passes the target on the requested side, whereas FlowVLA fails. In Approach, TGRPO also succeeds where FlowVLA fails. Both policies succeed in the illustrated Retreat, Ascend/Descend, Land, and Surround episodes. These examples illustrate how TGRPO can improve motion accuracy and adherence to spatial instructions.
blocks.zh: 图9比较了FlowVLA及其TGRPO培训后政策对涉及8个任务类型的配对测试事件。 在Shift中,TGRPO更密切地跟踪所要求的迁移,并在FlowVLA失败的情况下成功. 在旋转中, TGRPO 执行顺时针旋转 89.9 ∘ 89.9 ^{\ Circ} 90 ∘ 90 ^{\ Circ} 指令, 将 FlowVLA 的过射修正为 200.6 ∘ 200.6 ^{\ Circ} 。 在Pass中,TGRPO成功通过所请求一侧的目标,而FlowVLA失败. 在方法方面,TGRPO在FlowVLA失败的情况下也成功. 这两项政策都成功地在插图式的务虚会、Ascend/Descend、Land和周边事件上取得成功。 这些例子说明TGRPO如何能提高运动的准确性和遵守空间指示.
